integrity: All-dimensional analytical proof; finite exact arithmetic checker supplementary; no proof beyond the specified domain.
scientific_limitations: Canonical Frobenius matrix embedding of complete-bipartite fixed-cardinality matching polytopes only. The general vertex-transitivity/covariance ellipsoid principle is pre-existing; the rectangular three-mode spectrum and rank-saturation anisotropy classification are the claimed contributions. Previous enclosing-sphere and inscribed-ellipsoid results do not imply the whole enclosing ellipsoid. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Löwner ellipsoids of rectangular fixed-cardinality assignment polytopes and a sharp saturation anisotropy transition
